summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release on Monthly New Residential Construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for housing starts disaggregated into total, single-family (1 unit), and buildings with five or more units. The table includes specific data for July 2022 (revised) and August 2022 (preliminary), covering the first month of the task's required 2022/08 to 2025/05 period. These figures enable the calculation of month-over-month changes in total starts and the identification of which sector (single-family vs. 5+ units) was the larger driver for August 2022. The document is preliminary and subject to revision, which must be accounted for against subsequent reports per the task's precedence rule.
